# heic-to 1.6.5

`heic-to.js` is the unmodified IIFE build from
https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.5.tgz
(`package/dist/iife/heic-to.js`). It is loaded on demand by the thumbnail editor
to decode HEIC/HEIF locally, without uploading the source image.

Upstream source and build instructions: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
License: LGPL-3.0; see `LICENSE`.
The bundle includes libheif 1.23.5 (https://github.com/strukturag/libheif).
The separate script can be replaced with a compatible build of `HeicTo`.
